mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (id, tenant_id, name, description, price, stock, category, image_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{isActive}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM products WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND name LIKE '%${q}%' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM products WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND name LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, category = #{category}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET deleted_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET stock = stock - #{qty}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{qty}
UPDATE products SET stock = stock + #{qty}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
